# Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue. Please also include relevant motivation and context.
List any dependencies that are required for this change.

## Type of change
Select options that are relevant.

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## Release
The patch version is worked out at release time from the git tags, so most pull
requests need nothing here. Tick one only if this should not be a patch:

- [ ] Minor or major release — I raised `VERSION` to the number I want
